subject: Route 28 Wellington Underpass Shared-Use Path
overview: MassDOT, the City of Medford, and the Department of Conservation and Recreation hosted a virtual public hearing on the 25% design for a proposed shared-use path and boardwalk beneath Route 28. Project leads presented the preliminary layout, right-of-way requirements, and environmental permitting steps before taking feedback from the public.

items.title: Introduction and Hearing Procedures
items.summary: MassDOT representatives outlined virtual hearing procedures, accessibility guidelines, and civil rights compliance policies.

items.title: Route 28 Underpass Shared-Use Path Presentation
items.summary: Engineers and officials presented the 25% design for a proposed $4.5 million 12-foot-wide shared-use path and timber boardwalk connecting McDonald Park to Station Landing under the Route 28 bridge over the Mystic River.

items.title: Public Comment and Questions
items.summary: Panelists answered public inquiries regarding surface paving materials, winter snow maintenance, bicycle safety barriers, construction access, dark-sky lighting, and signage.
